products.name: Daytime Dining Restaurant Services
products.description: Operation of full-service restaurants serving made-to-order breakfast, brunch, and lunch, with a focus on fresh ingredients and a chef-driven, seasonally rotating menu. Food is prepared in-restaurant without microwaves, heat lamps, or deep fryers, and delivered through in-restaurant dining, takeout, and third-party delivery.

products.name: Franchise Restaurant Operations
products.description: Licensing of the First Watch brand, menu, and operating procedures to franchisees, who operate restaurants under the First Watch system in exchange for initial fees, royalties, and contributions to marketing funds.

products.name: Fresh Juice and Beverage Program
products.description: Preparation and sale of fresh juices and specialty beverages, including premium iced coffees and an alcohol program, made in-house daily and offered as part of the restaurant menu.

products.name: Seating Products
products.description: Researches, designs, manufactures, and distributes a wide range of seating products for office, healthcare, educational, and residential environments. Production involves physical manufacturing and design expertise.

products.name: Furniture Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes modular and integrated furniture systems for offices and institutional settings, requiring physical manufacturing and design innovation.

products.name: Freestanding Furniture and Casegoods
products.description: Produces and sells freestanding furniture elements and casegoods for office, healthcare, educational, and residential use, involving physical manufacturing and design.

products.name: Storage Solutions
products.description: Designs and manufactures storage products for various environments, including offices and public spaces, requiring physical manufacturing and design.

products.name: Textiles, Leather, and Felt Products
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells textiles, leather, and felt materials for use in furniture and interior design, involving both physical manufacturing and design expertise.

products.name: Acoustic and Technology Solutions
products.description: Provides acoustical products and related technology solutions for interior environments, requiring specialized design and manufacturing.

products.name: Home Furnishings
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells home furnishings including furniture and décor for residential customers, delivered through retail stores, eCommerce, and catalogs.

products.name: Related Services (Design and Specification)
products.description: Provides design, interior planning, and product specification services to organizations and individuals, leveraging proprietary software and expertise.

products.name: mmWave Semiconductor ICs
products.description: Semiconductor integrated circuits (ICs) for millimeter wave (mmWave) wireless communications, including baseband and RF ICs, designed and manufactured using proprietary phased-array and beamforming technology. These ICs are used in applications such as fixed wireless access (FWA), point-to-point (PtP) and point-to-multipoint (PtMP) wireless links, military communications, and consumer electronics like AR/VR and wireless video streaming. Products are manufactured by third-party foundries and sold to OEMs and service providers.

products.name: mmWave Antenna Modules
products.description: Integrated antenna modules combining proprietary mmWave ICs and antenna technology, designed for rapid deployment in wireless infrastructure. These modules are used by OEMs and wireless internet service providers (WISPs) for high-capacity FWA networks, especially in the unlicensed 60 GHz band, and include enhanced software and protocols for network optimization. Modules are manufactured externally and sold as complete solutions.

products.name: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) Services and IP Licensing
products.description: Provision of specialized engineering services for custom semiconductor and wireless system development, as well as licensing of proprietary intellectual property (IP) related to mmWave and antenna technologies. These services are delivered by in-house engineering teams and generate revenue through project-based contracts and IP licensing agreements.

products.name: Memory Integrated Circuits (EOL)
products.description: Previously offered memory-denominated ICs (Bandwidth Engine ICs) for high-speed networking, communications, and data center applications. These products were manufactured by third-party foundries but have been discontinued, with only residual sales from remaining inventory expected after 2025.

products.name: Microcontrollers (MCUs)
products.description: Semiconductor devices integrating processor core, memory, and interface circuitry, used to control electronic equipment and analyze sensor inputs across automotive, industrial, and consumer applications. Manufactured using proprietary and standard process technologies, delivered as hardware with supporting software tools.

products.name: Application Processors (SoCs)
products.description: Highly integrated Arm-based processors with audio, video, graphics, and machine learning capabilities, targeted at consumer, industrial, and automotive applications. Delivered as hardware platforms with supporting software for secure, high-performance, and low-power applications.

products.name: Communication Processors
products.description: Arm-based processors with high-speed networking and I/O interfaces, used in enterprise, data-center, and service-provider communications infrastructure such as switches, routers, base stations, and gateways. Delivered as hardware with software support for Linux and real-time operating systems.

products.name: Wireless Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Semiconductor chipsets and integrated SoCs providing wireless connectivity (NFC, UWB, Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Wi-Fi) for integration into mobile devices, wearables, automotive infotainment, and smart industrial devices. Delivered as hardware components for device manufacturers.

products.name: Analog and Interface Products
products.description: Analog and mixed-signal semiconductor devices including power management, audio processing, battery management, networking interfaces, and custom analog solutions for automotive, industrial, and mobile markets. Delivered as hardware components for system integration.

products.name: Radio Frequency (RF) Devices and Power Amplifiers
products.description: High-performance RF power amplifiers and transistors (LDMOS, GaN, GaAs) for wireless infrastructure, including 5G base stations, as well as low-noise amplifiers for various wireless and automotive applications. Delivered as hardware components for OEMs and infrastructure providers.

products.name: Security Controllers
products.description: Integrated circuits providing secure data storage, encryption, and authentication for smart cards, ePassports, payment cards, and secure devices. Delivered as hardware with embedded secure operating systems, meeting stringent global security certifications.

products.name: Sensors
products.description: Semiconductor-based environmental and inertial sensors (pressure, inertial, magnetic, gyroscopic) for automotive and industrial applications, enabling orientation detection, gesture recognition, and contextual awareness. Delivered as hardware components for integration into electronic systems.

products.name: System Solution Platforms and Middleware
products.description: Integrated hardware and software platforms, including safety case enablement and middleware for software-defined vehicles (SDVs), smart factories, robotics, and smart buildings. Delivered as combined solutions to enable rapid deployment and integration of advanced features in customer systems.

products.name: Family Safety and Device Management Software (SafePath)
products.description: A carrier-grade, white-label software platform delivered to mobile network operators and cable operators, enabling them to offer family safety solutions such as location tracking, parental controls, driver safety, and device management for smartphones and IoT devices. Delivered as SaaS or pre-installed software, often integrated into mobile rate plans or devices.

products.name: Premium Voicemail and Messaging Platform (CommSuite)
products.description: A software platform for mobile service providers that delivers next-generation voicemail experiences, including visual voicemail, premium voicemail, and voice-to-text transcription, installed on Android handsets and offered to both postpaid and prepaid subscribers.

products.name: Retail Display Management Platform (ViewSpot)
products.description: A software platform for wireless carriers and retailers to centrally manage and update interactive demo content on in-store smart devices, enabling engaging and targeted retail experiences. (Note: Product was divested in June 2025.)

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: The company provides cloud-based residential and commercial real estate brokerage services, facilitating property transactions through a network of licensed agents and brokers. Services are delivered digitally via a proprietary technology platform, reducing the need for physical offices and enabling operations across multiple countries.

products.name: Agent Support and Professional Development Services
products.description: The company offers training, education, business growth programs, and professional development resources to real estate agents and brokers, delivered through digital platforms, specialized divisions, and media properties. These services are designed to help agents expand their businesses and adapt to market changes.

products.name: Real Estate Technology Platforms
products.description: The company develops and provides proprietary digital platforms and tools, including a global property search platform (LYVVE), customer relationship management (CRM) solutions, and a 3D immersive virtual environment (FrameVR.io) for agent collaboration, training, and transaction management. These platforms are offered to agents and, in some cases, to consumers.

products.name: Podcast Content Production and Distribution
products.description: Production and distribution of original and exclusive podcasts across various genres (e.g., sports, entertainment, true crime, business) to listeners via major podcast platforms and PodcastOne's own website. Content is created in partnership with talent and distributed digitally, monetized primarily through advertising.

products.name: Advertising Solutions for Podcasts
products.description: Sales of integrated advertising products including embedded host-read ads, dynamic ads, segment sponsorships, programmatic ads, and branded podcast series, delivered across audio, video, and social channels. These solutions are sold to brands and agencies seeking targeted, measurable campaigns within PodcastOne's content network.

products.name: Podcast Hosting, Distribution, and Monetization Platform (LaunchpadOne)
products.description: Provision of a free, self-publishing podcast hosting, distribution, and monetization platform (LaunchpadOne) for independent podcasters, offering end-to-end podcast solutions including hosting, analytics, distribution to major platforms, and ad insertion technology. Monetization is achieved through ad sales and platform services.

products.name: Branded Podcasts and Content Development Services
products.description: Creation and production of custom-branded podcast series and episodes for corporate clients and advertisers, providing 100% share of voice and tailored content development to support brand marketing objectives. Delivered as a service, often including production, distribution, and promotional support.

products.name: Live Events and Merchandise
products.description: Organization of live events and tours featuring podcast talent, as well as the sale of branded merchandise related to podcasts and creators. These are offered as extensions of the podcast brands and provide additional engagement and monetization opportunities.

products.name: Western Boots
products.description: A wide assortment of western boots for men, women, and children, sourced from leading brands and exclusive in-house labels, sold through physical stores and e-commerce platforms. These are physically manufactured products requiring inventory management and retail distribution.

products.name: Work Boots
products.description: Durable work boots, including safety-toe and specialty boots for physically demanding jobs, sourced from top brands and exclusive labels, sold in stores and online. These require compliance with safety standards and are distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Western and Work Apparel
products.description: A broad range of western and work-related apparel, including denim, shirts, outerwear, overalls, flame-resistant and high-visibility clothing, for men, women, and children. These are manufactured garments distributed via retail stores and e-commerce.

products.name: Western and Work Accessories
products.description: Accessories such as cowboy hats, belts, belt buckles, western-style jewelry, handbags, and gifts, complementing the footwear and apparel lines. These are physical goods sourced from various suppliers and exclusive brands, sold in-store and online.

products.name: Exclusive Brand Products
products.description: Proprietary lines of boots, apparel, and accessories under exclusive in-house brands (e.g., Cody James, Shyanne, Idyllwind, Hawx), designed and sourced by Boot Barn, available only through their channels. These are manufactured products differentiated by brand exclusivity.

products.name: E-commerce Retailing
products.description: Online retailing of all core product categories (boots, apparel, accessories) through proprietary websites and third-party marketplaces, supported by omni-channel fulfillment options such as buy online, pick up in-store and same day delivery. This is a digital sales and logistics service.

products.name: Event Pop-up Shops
products.description: Temporary retail shops set up at major western events, rodeos, and concerts, offering the full range of merchandise to event attendees. This involves physical retail operations outside permanent store locations.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing of Metal Components and Assemblies
products.description: Provides end-to-end contract manufacturing services for OEMs, including design, prototyping, fabrication, stamping, machining, aluminum extrusion, tube bending, welding, coating, assembly, and logistics. Products include highly engineered metal components, weldments, tubes, tanks, frames, enclosures, and finished assemblies for diverse end markets. Production is performed in large-scale, highly automated U.S. facilities using advanced manufacturing technologies.

products.name: Aftermarket Components and Assemblies
products.description: Manufactures and supplies replacement and service parts, as well as assemblies, for OEM customers' equipment after initial sale. These components are produced using the same advanced manufacturing processes as original production parts and are delivered as part of ongoing customer support.

products.name: Precision Metal Enclosures and Power Infrastructure Products
products.description: Designs and manufactures precision metal enclosures, cabinets, racks, frames, panels, and sub-assemblies for data center and critical power applications. These products are produced using advanced metal fabrication, laser cutting, and coating technologies to meet stringent requirements for mission-critical environments.

products.name: PEO Services
products.description: Comprehensive human capital management (HCM) solutions delivered via a co-employment model, including payroll processing, payroll tax administration, TriNet-sponsored employee benefits, risk mitigation, compliance consulting, and HR advisory, primarily for SMBs. Delivered through a combination of technology platform and high-touch service teams.

products.name: ASO Services (including HR Plus)
products.description: Administrative Services Organization (ASO) solutions providing SaaS-based HR administration, payroll processing, benefits administration (for third-party benefits), and compliance management, without co-employment or TriNet-sponsored health plans. Delivered through a technology platform with significant service support.

products.name: Employee Benefits Administration
products.description: Administration and sponsorship of a broad range of employee benefit and insurance programs (health, dental, vision, disability, life, retirement, FSAs, HSAs, COBRA, supplemental insurance) for PEO clients, leveraging TriNet's scale to offer competitive plans. Includes plan selection, enrollment, and compliance support.

products.name: Payroll Processing and Payroll Tax Administration
products.description: Multi-state payroll processing, tax administration, and related services (including time and attendance, expense management, and tax credit support) for both PEO and ASO clients, delivered via online and mobile technology platforms.

products.name: Risk Mitigation and Compliance Services
products.description: Risk management and compliance consulting services, including employment law guidance, workers' compensation insurance, EPLI coverage, workplace safety assessments, and regulatory compliance support, primarily for PEO clients but also available to ASO clients.

products.name: HR Consulting and Advisory Services
products.description: Professional HR consulting and advisory services, including talent management, retention, terminations, benefits enrollment, immigration, payroll tax credits, and industry-specific HR topics, delivered by HR, benefits, payroll, and compliance professionals via technology platforms and direct consultation.

products.name: Technology Platform (HR Management Software)
products.description: Cloud-based technology platform providing online and mobile tools for HR management, payroll, benefits administration, workforce analytics, and self-service HR transactions for both PEO and ASO clients. Includes workforce analytics and reporting capabilities.

products.name: Contractor and Global Workforce Support
products.description: Software and service solutions for onboarding, managing, and paying independent contractors, as well as payroll and HR support for employees outside the U.S. through international employer of record partners.

products.name: TriNet Assistant (AI-powered HR Support Suite)
products.description: Suite of human-centered, AI-powered capabilities designed to deliver intelligent and responsive HR support with privacy and security controls, expected to launch in 2026.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides secured and unsecured loans to businesses, including commercial mortgage loans, commercial construction loans, revolving lines of credit, and loans secured by business assets. These are delivered through in-person relationship management and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgages, home equity loans, and lines of credit for primary and secondary residences, including loans secured by 1-4 family properties, delivered through both branch and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans such as auto loans, credit cards, cash reserve, and installment loans to individuals, delivered through branches and digital platforms, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a range of deposit accounts including personal and business checking, money market, savings, and time deposits, accessible via branches and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and capital management.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides business clients with cash management solutions such as TreasuryDirect, Automated Clearing House origination, Remote Deposit Capture, and digital invoicing, delivered via digital platforms and requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers online, mobile, and telephone banking services for both consumers and businesses, enabling account access, transactions, and information management, requiring digital infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Franchise Lending Marketplace (BoeFly)
products.description: Operates a digital fintech marketplace connecting franchisors, franchisees, and lenders, facilitating franchisee applicant vetting and access to capital through proprietary technology and a network of partner banks.

products.name: Merchant Services
products.description: Provides merchant services including payment processing and related solutions to business clients, delivered through partnerships and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Retirement Accounts
products.description: Offers retirement account products such as IRAs to consumers, managed through branches and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and financial management.

products.name: Safe Deposit and Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Provides safe deposit boxes, wire transfers, and related ancillary services to consumers and businesses, delivered through physical branches and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer, Technology, and Business Branded Products
products.description: A broad portfolio of branded products used in schools, homes, and workplaces, including office supplies, technology accessories, and business essentials. Products are manufactured in-house (40%) and sourced from third parties (60%), leveraging global supply chain and brand recognition.

products.name: Technology Accessories and Gaming Accessories
products.description: Technology peripherals and gaming accessories, including products that require licensing rights with gaming console manufacturers and video game publishers. These are developed internally and with technology partners, and depend on compatibility certifications.

products.name: Calendars, Planners, and Organizational Products
products.description: Branded calendars, planners, and organizational tools for personal and business use, produced through a mix of in-house manufacturing and third-party sourcing, and distributed globally.

products.name: Writing Instruments and Art Supplies
products.description: Writing instruments and art supplies, including pens, markers, and art materials, sold under various brands and tailored to regional preferences. Products are manufactured and sourced globally.

products.name: Filing, Storage, and Organization Products
products.description: Filing, storage, and organization solutions such as binders, folders, and storage boxes, produced under multiple brands and distributed through diverse retail and commercial channels.

products.name: School and Student Supplies
products.description: A range of school and student supplies, including notebooks, backpacks, and related items, marketed under well-known brands and distributed globally, especially during back-to-school seasons.

products.name: Office Equipment and Presentation Products
products.description: Office equipment and presentation products such as shredders, laminators, binding machines, and whiteboards, sold under established brands and distributed to businesses and consumers.

products.name: Stapling and Fastening Products
products.description: Staplers, punches, and other fastening products, manufactured and sourced globally, and sold under recognized brands for office and home use.

products.name: Luxury and Upper Upscale Hotel Ownership
products.description: Ownership of a geographically diverse portfolio of primarily luxury and upper-upscale hotels, operated under major international brands (e.g., Marriott, Hyatt, Hilton, AccorHotels) and independent brands. These hotels are physical assets requiring significant capital investment, ongoing renovations, and are operated by third-party managers under long-term agreements.

products.name: Resort Hotel Ownership
products.description: Ownership of resort hotels in destination locations with limited supply growth, featuring superior amenities and unique experiential offerings. These are physical properties requiring substantial capital and are managed by third parties.

products.name: Convention and Group-Oriented Hotel Ownership
products.description: Ownership of convention destination hotels in urban and resort markets, featuring extensive and high-quality meeting facilities, often connected to prominent convention centers. These are large-scale physical assets catering to group and event business.

products.name: Condominium and Timeshare Unit Sales
products.description: Development and sale of condominium and timeshare units on excess land adjacent to hotel properties. This involves real estate development, construction, and sales to external customers, often as part of value enhancement initiatives.

products.name: Equity Investments in Select Service and Extended Stay Hotels
products.description: Non-controlling equity interests in joint ventures that own select service and extended stay hotels, providing exposure to additional lodging segments. These are financial investments rather than direct operations, but generate returns from hotel performance.

products.name: Vacation Ownership (Timeshare) Development
products.description: Ownership interest in vacation ownership (timeshare) developments, such as the 131-unit project in Maui, Hawaii. This involves real estate development and sales of timeshare interests to consumers.

products.name: QuantaFlo Vascular Testing System
products.description: A patented, FDA-cleared medical device and software platform that measures arterial blood flow in extremities to aid in the diagnosis of peripheral artery disease (PAD) and, pending further FDA clearance, other cardiovascular diseases. The system is manufactured in the U.S. via contract manufacturers and delivered to healthcare providers under a license or per-test fee model, with training and support provided online or in person.

products.name: Distribution of Complementary Chronic Disease Management Products
products.description: Distribution of third-party products related to chronic disease management, such as diabetes and Alzheimer's diagnostics, to healthcare providers through marketing and distribution agreements. These products are selected to complement the core vascular testing offering and are delivered via the company's established sales channels.

products.name: Semiconductor Test Systems
products.description: Automated test equipment for semiconductor devices, including wafer level, device package, and system level testing, manufactured using proprietary hardware and software platforms and delivered to semiconductor manufacturers and test providers worldwide.

products.name: Product Test Systems
products.description: Test equipment and service offerings for high performance electronic and photonic assemblies, sub-assemblies, modules, and components, including circuit-board test and inspection systems, wireless test systems, photonic integrated circuit test solutions, and defense and aerospace test instrumentation, delivered to a broad range of electronics and industrial customers.

products.name: Collaborative Robotic Arms (Cobots)
products.description: Collaborative robotic arms designed for industrial automation, manufactured in-house and delivered globally, featuring intuitive programming, flexible deployment, and safety features for use alongside human workers in manufacturing and logistics environments.

products.name: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs)
products.description: Autonomous mobile robots for material handling and logistics automation, produced in company facilities and integrated into customer operations to improve efficiency and safety in manufacturing and warehouse environments.

products.name: Water and Wastewater Transport Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and services pumps and related equipment for the transport of water, wastewater, and stormwater, primarily for utility and industrial customers. Products are physically manufactured and delivered through direct and indirect channels.

products.name: Water and Wastewater Treatment Equipment
products.description: Provides filtration, disinfection, biological treatment, and process water systems for treating drinking water and wastewater. These are engineered, physical products installed at customer sites, requiring manufacturing and technical expertise.

products.name: Building and Industrial Water Systems
products.description: Manufactures and supplies pumps, valves, heat exchangers, controls, and dispensing equipment for water use in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Products are physically manufactured and distributed mainly through indirect channels.

products.name: Smart Metering and Network Communication Solutions
products.description: Develops and delivers smart meters, network communication devices, and related infrastructure for water, electricity, and gas utilities. Includes physical devices and supporting communication networks, often requiring regulated infrastructure and digital integration.

products.name: Water Quality Analytics and Instrumentation
products.description: Provides analytical instruments and sensor devices for measuring and analyzing water quality, flow, and level in clean water, wastewater, and environmental applications. Products are manufactured devices, often used in rugged or remote locations.

products.name: Digital Software and Managed Services for Water Utilities
products.description: Offers digital software platforms, cloud-based analytics, remote monitoring, and managed services to optimize water and energy distribution networks. Delivered as software and digital services, often integrated with physical infrastructure.

products.name: Comprehensive Water Solutions and Services
products.description: Provides preventative maintenance, rapid response, outsourced operations, environmental remediation, odor and corrosion control, and asset management services for water and wastewater systems. Delivered through in-person human labor, technical expertise, and digital tools.

products.name: Specialty Dewatering Equipment and Rental Services
products.description: Offers sale and rental of specialty dewatering pumps and equipment for safe removal or draining of groundwater and surface water from construction and industrial sites, including emergency response. Involves physical equipment and on-site service.

products.name: Solid Waste Collection and Disposal Services
products.description: Comprehensive collection, transfer, and disposal of solid waste for residential, commercial, and industrial customers, including operation of landfills and transfer stations. Services are delivered via a large fleet and extensive infrastructure, requiring significant physical assets and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Recycling Processing and Sales
products.description: Collection, processing, and resale of recyclable materials such as paper, cardboard, glass, plastic, and metal, using advanced sorting and processing facilities. Includes brokerage services for third parties and organics processing (mulch, compost, soil amendments).

products.name: Renewable Energy Production (Landfill Gas-to-Energy)
products.description: Development and operation of facilities that capture landfill gas and convert it into renewable natural gas (RNG), electricity, heat, and steam, which are sold to utilities, industrial customers, and natural gas suppliers. Involves significant infrastructure and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Healthcare Regulated Waste and Compliance Services (RWCS)
products.description: Collection, processing (autoclaving, alternative technologies, incineration), and disposal of regulated medical, pharmaceutical, and hazardous waste for healthcare customers, requiring specialized handling, treatment, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Secure Information Destruction Services (SID)
products.description: Collection and secure destruction (shredding) of confidential and personal information, primarily sorted office paper, for business customers, with shredded material recycled. Delivered via on-site and off-site destruction facilities with chain-of-custody protocols.

products.name: Organics Processing and Sales
products.description: Collection and processing of organic waste (food and yard waste) into mulch, compost, soil amendments, and renewable energy, using a network of specialized facilities. Products are marketed and sold to customers.

products.name: Hazardous Waste Disposal Services
products.description: Operation of hazardous waste landfills and deep well injection facilities for the treatment and long-term containment of hazardous waste, including pre-treatment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Electronic Components Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a broad range of electronic components, including semiconductors and IP&E products, to OEMs and EMS providers, leveraging global logistics, warehousing, and value-added services. Products are sourced from leading suppliers and delivered via a global sales and distribution network.

products.name: Enterprise Computing Solutions Distribution
products.description: Provision and distribution of enterprise computing solutions, including datacenter, cloud, security, analytics, storage, compute, and networking products, to VARs and MSPs, supported by integration, engineering, and logistics services.

products.name: Supply Chain Services for Electronics
products.description: Fee-based supply chain services for electronics customers, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, financial management, and data analytics, designed to optimize and support complex electronics supply chains.

products.name: Engineering and Design Services
products.description: Provision of engineering and design services, including software development, product design, and integrated circuit design, to support customers in developing new products and integrating supplier components.

products.name: Integration and Product Lifecycle Services
products.description: Integration services offering full product lifecycle solutions, from prototyping to volume production readiness, including manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, and customer support for technology products.

products.name: Cloud Marketplace and Management Platform (ArrowSphere)
products.description: Provision of ArrowSphere, a digital marketplace and management platform for software and cloud solutions, enabling VARs and MSPs to manage, differentiate, and scale their as-a-service businesses.

products.name: Go-to-Market Outsourcing Services for IT Suppliers
products.description: Strategic outsourcing services for IT suppliers, managing part or all of their go-to-market activities, including selling and marketing, under contractual fee models to streamline supplier operations.

products.name: Coach-Guided Lifestyle and Weight Loss Programs
products.description: Personalized, coach-supported programs that guide clients through structured weight loss and metabolic health improvement, delivered digitally and through human interaction, leveraging proprietary habit-formation frameworks and community support.

products.name: OPTAVIA Fuelings
products.description: Scientifically formulated, pre-portioned meal replacements and snacks containing balanced macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, and probiotics, manufactured in regulated facilities and shipped directly to clients as part of nutrition plans.

products.name: OPTAVIA ACTIVE
products.description: A line of sports nutrition products including essential amino acid blends and whey protein, designed to support muscle health and recovery, manufactured to high quality standards and certified for sports nutrition safety.

products.name: OPTAVIA ASCEND
products.description: Targeted nutrition mini meals and daily nutrient packs (multivitamin, minerals, omega-3 supplements) formulated to support clients on GLP-1 medications or in weight management, providing high protein, fiber, and key micronutrients.

products.name: Nutrition and Weight Management Plans
products.description: A suite of evidence-based, structured nutrition plans (e.g., 5 & 1 Plan, 4 & 2 & 1 Plan, Optimization Plan, GLP-1 Nutrition Support Plan) combining proprietary meal products with self-prepared meals and coach guidance, delivered digitally and through direct-to-consumer product shipments.

products.name: Habits of Health Transformational System
products.description: A proprietary educational and behavioral change system delivered through digital tools, printed materials, and coach support, designed to help clients build sustainable healthy habits for long-term metabolic health.

products.name: TARA-002 for Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC)
products.description: An investigational cell therapy produced from inactivated Streptococcus pyogenes, administered intravesically for the treatment of NMIBC. Manufactured using a proprietary process at a cGMP-compliant facility and delivered via local bladder instillation in clinical settings.

products.name: TARA-002 for Lymphatic Malformations (LMs)
products.description: An investigational cell therapy based on inactivated Streptococcus pyogenes, administered via intracystic injection for the treatment of macrocystic and mixed-cystic lymphatic malformations, primarily in pediatric patients. Manufactured using proprietary processes at a cGMP-compliant facility.

products.name: IV Choline Chloride for Parenteral Support (PS) Patients
products.description: An investigational intravenous substrate replacement therapy providing choline for patients receiving parenteral support (nutrition and fluids) who cannot obtain sufficient choline enterally. Manufactured as a sterile injectable formulation at a cGMP-compliant facility and delivered via IV infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: New Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of new heavy construction, material handling, and environmental processing equipment as an exclusive regional distributor for major OEMs. Involves physical inventory, OEM relationships, and regulated distribution agreements.

products.name: Used Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of used equipment sourced from trade-ins, lease returns, or open market purchases. Delivered through physical inventory and branch network.

products.name: Equipment Rentals
products.description: Rental of heavy construction, compact, aerial, material handling, and other specialized equipment to customers on daily, weekly, or monthly terms. Requires maintaining a large rental fleet and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Rental Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of lightly used equipment from the rental fleet, including both rent-to-rent and rent-to-sell models. Involves managing equipment lifecycle and resale channels.

products.name: Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of OEM replacement parts for equipment, both to external customers and to support the company’s rental fleet. Involves inventory management and exclusive distribution rights.

products.name: Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance, repair, preventative maintenance, and warranty services for customer-owned equipment. Delivered by skilled technicians through a service infrastructure.

products.name: Automated Equipment Installation and Warehouse Management Systems Integration
products.description: Design and build services for automated equipment installation and integration of warehouse management systems, primarily within the Material Handling segment. Delivered as a project-based service.

products.name: Wholesale Equipment Distribution (Master Dealer)
products.description: Wholesale distribution of OEM equipment as a master dealer with rights to distribute across significant geographic territories, such as North America. Involves contractual OEM relationships and logistics.

products.name: Atacicept
products.description: A biologic fusion protein (TACI-Fc) that inhibits both BAFF and APRIL cytokines, developed and manufactured using cGMP processes similar to monoclonal antibodies, and delivered as a ready-to-use subcutaneous injection (pre-filled syringe or autoinjector) for at-home self-administration. Initially targeted for IgA nephropathy (IgAN), with ongoing development for other autoimmune kidney diseases (pMN, FSGS, MCD) and potential expansion to additional B-cell mediated autoimmune diseases.

products.name: MAU868
products.description: A human monoclonal antibody (IgG1) targeting the VP1 protein of BK virus (BKV), manufactured using CHO cells and standard antibody processes, administered intravenously for the treatment of reactivated BK infection (BK viremia and BKV nephropathy) in kidney transplant recipients. The product is in late-stage clinical development and is positioned as a potential first-in-class therapy for this indication.

products.name: VT-109
products.description: A novel, next-generation dual BAFF/APRIL inhibitor (engineered Fc-fusion protein containing BCMA variant), currently in preclinical development for the treatment of B-cell–mediated autoimmune diseases. Manufacturing is in early-stage process development, leveraging biologic production expertise.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate and multifamily properties, including owner-occupied, non-owner occupied, and multifamily buildings. These loans are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending (C&I)
products.description: Provision of commercial term loans, lines of credit, equipment financing, and revolving credit to small and medium-sized businesses. These loans are underwritten based on business cash flow and collateral, and require in-person relationship management and digital servicing.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for commercial and residential construction and land development projects. These loans are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of first and second lien mortgage loans for one-to-four family residential properties, including home equity loans. Loans are underwritten to secondary market standards and may be retained or sold; requires property appraisals and digital/in-person servicing.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans to individuals, including unsecured loans and loans secured by deposits, vehicles, or real property. Underwriting is based on creditworthiness and collateral, delivered through digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to local farmers and agricultural businesses, generally secured by farmland and equipment. Requires physical underwriting and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Municipal Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to qualified local municipalities, generally supported by taxing authority and often secured by collateral. Involves specialized underwriting and compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a comprehensive range of deposit accounts and services to retail, business, and nonprofit customers, including demand accounts, money market, savings, certificates of deposit, and escrow-type deposits. Delivered via branch network, digital banking, and remote channels.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Provision of business deposit products and services such as remote deposit, cash management, and commercial transaction accounts to business customers. Delivered through technology platforms and relationship managers.

products.name: Kitchen Cabinetry
products.description: Manufactured kitchen cabinets available in made-to-order and stock options, produced in company-owned facilities and distributed nationally through home centers, builders, and independent dealers. Products are offered in various designs, finishes, and door styles.

products.name: Bath Cabinetry
products.description: Manufactured bath cabinets, available in both made-to-order and stock categories, produced in company facilities and distributed through multiple channels nationwide. Products feature a range of designs, finishes, and door styles.

products.name: Home Organization Products
products.description: Stock home organization products such as storage solutions, manufactured in company facilities and distributed through national channels. These products are exclusively stock and focus on organization needs beyond kitchen and bath.

products.name: Office Cabinetry
products.description: Manufactured office cabinetry products, produced in company facilities and distributed through the same channels as other cabinetry lines. These products are designed for office and workspace applications.

products.name: Cabinet Hardware
products.description: A range of cabinet hardware products, including handles and accessories, offered alongside cabinetry lines and distributed through the same national channels.

products.name: Turnkey Cabinet Installation Services
products.description: Complete turnkey installation services for cabinetry, including in-house design, measurement, and installation, provided to direct builder customers via a network of service centers across the United States.

products.name: Agricultural Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and distributes specialized farm machinery including feed processing equipment, forage equipment, manure spreaders, sugar beet harvesting equipment, bale processors, and dirt work equipment. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through a dealer network to agricultural customers.

products.name: Aftermarket Service Parts for Agricultural Equipment
products.description: Provides aftermarket service parts to support the operation and maintenance of branded and OEM agricultural equipment. These parts are physically produced and distributed to end users and dealers.

products.name: Modular Buildings for Science and Agriculture
products.description: Designs, manufactures, delivers, and installs custom modular buildings, including animal containment facilities and research laboratories, for academic, government, public health, and private sector clients. These are physically manufactured, delivered, and installed turnkey to customer specifications.

products.name: Leasing of Modular Buildings
products.description: Offers leasing options for modular buildings to customers needing temporary research or animal containment facilities. This service involves providing access to manufactured buildings for a defined period.

products.name: Lattice-Boom Crawler Cranes
products.description: Heavy-duty cranes with lattice booms, designed, manufactured, and assembled primarily from steel, used for lifting in construction and industrial projects. Delivered as large, transportable units to job sites and erected on location.

products.name: Tower Cranes
products.description: A full line of tower cranes, including top-slewing and self-erecting models, manufactured in multiple countries, used for lifting and distributing materials in commercial and residential construction. Delivered as modular units for on-site assembly and operation.

products.name: Mobile Hydraulic Cranes
products.description: A diversified line of mobile hydraulic cranes, including rough-terrain, all-terrain, truck-mounted, telescopic crawler, industrial, and boom truck types, manufactured and assembled from steel and components, used for lifting in various industrial and construction applications. Delivered as complete, roadable or transportable vehicles.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Accessories
products.description: Sale and distribution of replacement parts and accessories for crane products, stocked at global distribution centers to ensure availability and reduce downtime for customers. Delivered through a global network of distributors and company-owned locations.

products.name: Crane Rental Services
products.description: Rental of cranes, including tower and mobile cranes, from company-owned fleets in the United States and Europe, providing customers with flexible access to lifting equipment without ownership. Delivered through direct-to-customer branches and service locations.

products.name: Aftermarket Field Services and Technical Support
products.description: Provision of field service work, maintenance, repairs, technical support, troubleshooting, and remote diagnostics for crane products, delivered by certified technicians at customer sites or remotely. Includes erection and decommissioning services for cranes.

products.name: Crane and Major Component Remanufacturing
products.description: Remanufacturing services to restore cranes or major components to original specifications, involving disassembly, cleaning, repair, replacement, and updating of controls and safety devices. Delivered under the EnCORE brand using genuine parts and thorough testing.

products.name: Upfitting Services
products.description: Specialized upfitting of stock chassis into purpose-built, job-ready equipment for industries such as utilities, railroads, and construction, performed at dedicated operations centers under the Upfits by Aspen Equipment brand.

products.name: Crane Operator and Technical Training Services
products.description: Technical training services for crane operation and maintenance, provided at dedicated training centers or on-site for customers and service technicians, covering all crane products.

products.name: Telematics and Digital Asset Management Solutions
products.description: Subscription-based telematics and digital solutions, such as Potain CONNECT, Grove CONNECT, and ServiceMax, providing real-time remote access to crane service information, asset tracking, and diagnostics to enhance support and minimize downtime.

products.name: Cinema On-Screen Advertising
products.description: Advertising inventory sold to national, regional, and local businesses, delivered via pre-show and post-show segments (The Noovie Show and CineLife Show) on movie theater screens. Content is produced and distributed digitally, with customizable targeting by location, film, and audience demographics.

products.name: Lobby Advertising and Promotions
products.description: Advertising and promotional products sold for display in theater lobbies, including video screens (Lobby Entertainment Network), signage, brand activations, product sampling, and advertising on concession items. Delivered through physical installations and digital screens in high-traffic lobby areas.

products.name: Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) Advertising
products.description: Advertising inventory sold for display on digital screens outside of theaters, such as in convenience stores and college campuses, leveraging partnerships with digital place-based properties. Delivered digitally and sold on national, regional, local, and programmatic levels.

products.name: Data-Driven and Omnichannel Advertising Solutions (NCMx Suite)
products.description: Integrated marketing solutions leveraging proprietary data, analytics, and digital platforms (NCMx, NCM Boost, NCM Boomerang, NCM Bullseye, NCM Blueprint) to enable targeted, measurable, and retargeted advertising campaigns across cinema, digital, mobile, CTV, and OTT channels. Delivered digitally and bundled with on-screen or lobby advertising.

products.name: Programmatic and Self-Serve Advertising Marketplaces
products.description: Automated platforms allowing advertisers to purchase cinema and lobby advertising inventory in real-time or via self-service, with options for programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace transactions. Delivered digitally and enables customized targeting and scheduling.

products.name: Beverage Concessionaire Advertising
products.description: On-screen advertising time sold to theater owners' beverage suppliers as part of their agreements to sell branded beverages in theaters. Delivered as part of the pre-show program and priced under long-term contracts.

products.name: Advertising Creative Services
products.description: Production of advertising creative and branded content for clients, including pre- and post-production services and content integration into cinema and digital campaigns. Delivered by internal creative teams for a fee, primarily to local clients and national brands.

products.name: Swimming Pool Supplies and Equipment
products.description: Wholesale distribution of swimming pool chemicals, equipment (pumps, heaters, filters, lights), maintenance supplies, and accessories, sourced from manufacturers and delivered via a network of sales centers to pool professionals and retailers.

products.name: Pool Building Materials and Hardscapes
products.description: Distribution of building materials for pool installations and remodeling, including concrete, plumbing, electrical components, pool surfaces, decking, tile, hardscapes, and natural stone, delivered through sales centers and showrooms.

products.name: Irrigation and Landscape Maintenance Products
products.description: Distribution of residential and commercial irrigation systems, landscape maintenance products, power equipment, hardscapes, and specialty outdoor products, primarily through the Horizon network to contractors and professionals.

products.name: Commercial Pool Products and Services
products.description: Distribution of specialized products for commercial pool installations, including certified heaters, safety equipment, commercial decking, pumps, and filters, as well as bid-to-spec design assistance for large projects like hotels and universities.

products.name: Fiberglass Pools, Hot Tubs, and Packaged Pool Kits
products.description: Distribution of prefabricated fiberglass pools, hot tubs, and packaged pool kits (including walls, liners, braces, coping) for in-ground and above-ground pool installations, delivered to contractors and retailers.

products.name: Outdoor Living and Recreational Products
products.description: Distribution of discretionary outdoor living products such as grills, outdoor kitchen components, lighting, and other backyard leisure products, often bundled with pool and landscape projects.

products.name: Proprietary and Exclusive Brand Pool Chemicals and Products
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of proprietary and exclusive brand pool chemicals and related products, including re-packaged chemicals, primarily through owned brands and franchise networks.

products.name: Digital Pool Management and Water Testing Software
products.description: Provision of digital tools and software platforms for pool professionals and retailers, including water testing, service management, CRM, routing, billing, and e-commerce integration, delivered as digital applications and platforms.

products.name: Precious Metals Project Development
products.description: Paramount acquires, explores, and develops precious metals projects, primarily gold, in the United States, advancing properties through exploration, engineering, technical studies, and permitting toward potential production or sale. This involves significant in-person labor, regulatory compliance, and capital investment.

products.name: Sale or Joint Venture of Mineral Projects
products.description: Paramount monetizes its mineral projects by selling them to producers or entering into joint ventures with other companies, leveraging its exploration and development work to create value for external customers in the mining industry.

products.name: Mine Operation (Potential Future Service)
products.description: Paramount may build and operate small mines on its own, producing precious metals for sale, though current operations are focused on exploration and development rather than active mining and production.

products.name: Student and Consumer Loan Servicing
products.description: Comprehensive servicing of federally owned, FFELP, private education, and consumer loans for government agencies, financial institutions, and other third parties, using proprietary technology platforms and in-person customer support.

products.name: Education Technology and Payment Solutions
products.description: Digital platforms and services for K-12 and higher education institutions, including tuition payment plans, financial management, student information systems, learning management, and integrated payment processing, delivered via cloud-based software and subscription models.

products.name: Asset Generation and Management (Loan Portfolio Investment)
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, and management of student, consumer, and other loan portfolios, including earning net interest income and managing residual interests in loan securitizations, requiring significant financial capital and risk management expertise.

products.name: Private Education and Consumer Lending (Nelnet Bank)
products.description: Origination and purchase of private education and unsecured consumer loans, including refinance and in-school loans, delivered through an internet-based industrial bank platform regulated by the FDIC.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Provision of secure, PCI-compliant payment processing solutions for credit card and ACH transactions, serving educational institutions, businesses, and third-party software platforms, delivered via digital infrastructure.

products.name: Business Process Outsourcing Services
products.description: Outsourced contact center, processing, and administrative services for external clients, including inbound/outbound customer support, application processing, and account management, delivered by in-person and remote teams.

products.name: Reinsurance Services
products.description: Reinsurance of property and casualty insurance policies through captive insurance companies, involving risk sharing and underwriting for third-party carriers, requiring regulatory compliance and capital management.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Asset management and advisory services for third-party clients, primarily focused on student loan asset-backed securities and other asset classes, delivered through an SEC-registered investment advisor subsidiary.

products.name: Real Estate Investment and Management
products.description: Ownership and management of commercial real estate properties, including office, industrial, multifamily, and mixed-use assets, typically in partnership with third-party operators.

products.name: Renewable Energy Investment and Management
products.description: Equity investments and management services in renewable energy solar projects, including tax equity contributions, syndication with third-party partners, and consulting for solar developers, requiring specialized underwriting and project management.
